lines: Vex here. Top of the leaderboard, in case you were wondering. You weren't? Rude.
Command says I babysit you. Fine. Try to keep up, rookie.
{left} and {right} turn the ship. Spin all the way around. I'm timing you.
{forward} thrusts, {backward} reverses. See the beacon? Go touch it. Gently.
Walls don't move, by the way. They win every argument.
That bar up top? Energy. It's your health AND your ammo.
Fire everything and you die tired. Ask me how I know. Actually, don't.
Target practice. {gun} fires your guns. It's not even dodging. Embarrass it.
{bomb} drops a bomb. Slower, meaner. Throw one anywhere. Live a little.
Huh. Your engines just died. That's... not me. Definitely not me.
Radar's on. See the blue dots? Those aren't fans.
Okay, they're circling. Sit tight. They only bite a little.
Here, take my spare Shields. They eat the hits so you don't have to.
Your items are on the left. There's a Repel in there. Guess what it does.
{repel}! Shove them off you. Go on, make some space.
Now shoot them with {gun}. Yes, all of them. Yes, they shoot back.
Here, this should help. Super, on the house. Infinite ammo, zero excuses. Finish them.
Engines back. Not bad, rookie. Don't let it go to your head. That's my job.
That list? Everyone out here. Bounty is what you're worth. Mine's higher.
Banged up? The safe zone's on your radar. Nobody shoots in there. Rest up.
Those little boxes are greens. Enemies drop them when they die.
Fly through one to loot their destroyed ship. You could find something nice.
Chat time. Press Enter, and type something. Press Enter again to send.
Say hi to our friend. Be nice.

lines: Press Esc, then a number between 1 and 8 to swap your ship. Try one.
Then crawl back to the Warbird, ship 1.
Most games here are about flags or balls. Grab that flag. It's shiny.
The ball: fly over it, {gun} shoots it. Put it in the goal. Like I would.
That's the basics. You're almost not terrible. Almost.
F1 has the full manual. Need a refresher? ?tutorial. Now go lose to someone.

prompts.text: Bored already? Type ?skip and press Enter. Leaving? ?leave
New here? Type ?tutorial and press Enter. Vex will show you the ropes.
Nobody's flying right now. Type ?arena to see where the bots are.
